image_reference_use.replace: Source product labels, business claims, values and entities according to the new verified script.
image_reference_use.never_use: Rejected reconstruction screenshots as style references.

confidence.timing: Estimated teaching/cut anchors, not word alignment.

source_specific_observation.status: Sequence-level source observations are attached in prior_source_observations. The family motion grammar is a proposed reusable pattern, not a frame-exact claim about this instance.

reading_vs_reveal_rule: Reading direction and actual reveal order are separate. Prefer the source-specific observation when reconstructing; align adaptation order to what the new narration introduces.
